comment: RoboPaint's process rules (docs/benchmarks/robopaint.md). Per family: max_path_mm = path_factor x the pair's reference_path_mm, rounded up to round_mm; calligraphy and lettering: min_mark_width_mm = mark_factor x the pair's reference_mark_width_mm, rounded down to 0.01 mm (colouring in = path_mm > max_path_mm and mark_width_mm < min_mark_width_mm); paintings: the path budget path_mm <= max_path_mm and the sweep rule (max_scribble, max_scribble_share, scribble_min_mm). reference_path_mm / reference_mark_width_mm: the pair's reference solution (solution/oracle_qpos.npy) replayed with rcb_brush_strict's Session on the graders' instance (measure_reference.py, base image). oracle_evidence: the task.toml text per mode; oracle_evidence_family: a family's own texts; oracle_evidence_pairs: a pair's own texts (it wins over its family's). Calibration (2026-10-04, ws3): docs/benchmarks/robopaint.md. current_reference: a pair whose reference solution was re-made after its limits were set (2026-10-09): the current reference's path_mm and mark_width_mm (measure_reference.py), quoted in its oracle evidence; the limits stay on reference_path_mm / reference_mark_width_mm. change_log: a pair's README Change Log entries.
